rawInput.answer: During tree traversal in node.getValue (tree.go), when a wildChild is reached and its nType is `param`, gin scans the remaining path up to the next '/' (or end of string) and stores that substring as a Param{Key: n.path[1:], Value: val} appended into the shared *Params slice (with optional URL-unescaping); catchAll (`*name`) wildcards work the same way but take the rest of the path and use n.path[2:] as the key.
